text:
maria: Quick sync - we need a concise enterprise collateral bundle for upcoming launch. Target: one-page summary + two half-page assets (security controls + deployment decision matrix) and a short benchmark blurb. Draft by Mon.

aj: I'll take SLAs and routing snippet. Proposed benchmark headline: "Consistent sub-50ms p50 for short chat; up to 3x cost savings vs naive single-request serving." Too dense?

sam: That reads fine. Add micro-details for the benchmark appendix: workload shape and harness. Example to include:
```
Workload: 120 concurrent chat users, avg 28 tokens
Harness: 45m steady-state, warmed cache
Baseline: open model vX on single GPU
Result: p50 46ms, token cost -72%
```
Include link to full appendix.

liz: I'll craft the security half-page focusing on KMS/HSM, VPC peering, audit logs, SOC2 readiness. Topline CTA: "Private by default, auditable by design."

noah: I'll build the deployment decision matrix: rows for latency, cost predictability, data residency, scaling. Keep it copy/paste friendly.

maria: Also include an inbound routing snippet for contact form so high-intent leads hit enterprise sales. Example rule in the appendix for ops:
```
if (company_size >= 1000 || security_checkbox || requested_sla == 'enterprise') { route = 'enterprise-sales'; } else { route = 'self-serve'; }
```

aj: I'll map to Salesforce queue + tags: enterprise-slas, private-deploy.

sam: Webinar tie-in: 30min product + 10min Q&A. Speakers: eng lead, solutions engineer, customer success. Slide per deployment mode. Draft outline by Wed.

gtm-bot: Template: https://redwoodhq.notion/link/enterprise-collateral-template (use ENT-ONEPAGER-2025).

maria: Action items and owners assigned. I'll create a shared folder and track drafts.

liz: small ask - can the security blurb include a simple matrix of controls vs compliance frameworks? i'll add that in the half page.

maria: perfect, thanks everyone.
